status: Historical submitted-analysis provenance only; not a preregistration or current inferential result

analysis_notes.design: Associational weighted WLS with school fixed effects and class clustered standard errors
analysis_notes.interaction_hypothesis: The class contextual association is more protective when own perceived class support is lower; a positive interaction is expected if the protective slope attenuates as own support rises.
analysis_notes.mismatch_interaction_role: Referent mismatch comparator estimated in the same model family; not a causal negative control.

models.label: class_referent_own_perception_interaction
models.formula: z_distress_score ~ z_class_score * z_class_loo_mean + C(school_key) + C(gender) + C(grade9) + z_health + z_expectstress_p + z_income5 + z_medu + z_fedu + C(migrant_status)
